Schwanthalerhoehe — Munich, Germany

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Schwanthalerhoehe is one of Munich's 25 official Stadtbezirke (city districts). Polizeipraesidium Muenchen and the Statistisches Amt Muenchen recorded 1,960 total offences here in 2025, across a population of 28,684 residents (31 December 2024) — a rate of 6,833 offences per 100,000 residents, roughly 1.4x the citywide Stadtbezirk average. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy central, station, or nightlife-heavy district can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential district can show a low rate simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Munich — real Polizeipraesidium Muenchen / Statistisches Amt Muenchen figures, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data is not split here by time of day, so both figures shown here are the same.
